edition.en: Transcribed by Claude from a scan of My Memory (我底記憶, 1929) on Wikimedia Commons, and checked against the Wikisource text; first published in The Short Story Magazine (小說月報) in August 1928.
edition.zh: 据维基共享资源所藏《我底记忆》（1929）扫描页，由 Claude 校录，并与维基文库本对校；1928 年 8 月初刊于《小说月报》。

basis.en: First published in 1928; the author died in 1950. Public domain by age: the author died before 1956 and the text was published before 1931.
basis.zh: 1928 年首次发表，作者卒于 1950 年。作者卒于 1956 年前、作品发表于 1931 年前，按年限属公有领域。

note.en: A man with an oil-paper umbrella walks a long, lonely lane in the rain, hoping to meet a girl as sorrowful as lilac; she passes him like a dream and is gone. The poem made Dai Wangshu famous at twenty-three, and it is here for its music, the repetitions falling like rain. Notice that the last stanza repeats the first with one change, 逢着 (to meet) becoming 飄過 (to drift past), so that the hope grows smaller and truer.
note.zh: 一个撑着油纸伞的人，在悠长寂寥的雨巷里独自彷徨，希望逢着一个丁香一样结着愁怨的姑娘；她像梦一般从身旁飘过，便消散了。这首诗使二十三岁的戴望舒成名，收在这里，是为了它的音乐：那些重复像雨一样落下。留意最后一节重复第一节，只改了一处，“逢着”变成了“飘过”，希望变小了，也更真了。

excerpt.orig: 撐着油紙傘，獨自彷徨在悠長，悠長又寂寥的雨巷
excerpt.en: Holding an oil-paper umbrella, alone I wander down a long, long and lonely rainy lane
excerpt.zh: 撑着油纸伞，独自彷徨在悠长，悠长又寂寥的雨巷

gloss.en: An umbrella of bamboo ribs and paper made waterproof with tung oil, common in the towns of the south.
gloss.zh: 油纸伞：竹骨架、糊上桐油纸的伞，江南常见。

gloss.en: Dai Wangshu grew up in Hangzhou, a city of narrow lanes between high walls; he wrote the poem in 1927 while staying with his friend Shi Zhecun at Songjiang, near Shanghai.
gloss.zh: 戴望舒在杭州长大，那里多高墙夹着的窄巷。这首诗写于 1927 年，当时他避居上海附近松江的朋友施蛰存家中。

gloss.en: 丁香: lilac. Its tight clusters of buds, 丁香結, stood for knotted sorrow in classical poetry, as in Li Jing’s line ‘the lilac vainly knots its sorrow in the rain’.
gloss.zh: 丁香：丁香花蕾丛生如结，古诗词称“丁香结”，用来比喻愁思郁结，如南唐李璟“丁香空结雨中愁”。

gloss.en: 彳亍 (chìchù): to walk slowly, stopping and starting; the two characters are the left and right halves of 行, to walk.
gloss.zh: 彳亍（chì chù）：慢步走，走走停停。两字合起来正是“行”字。

gloss.en: 太息: to sigh deeply, an old literary word, as in Qu Yuan’s ‘Long I sigh and wipe away my tears’.
gloss.zh: 太息：叹息，旧诗文用语，如屈原《离骚》“长太息以掩涕兮”。

gloss.en: 頹圯: crumbling. The 圯 printed here stands for 圮 (pǐ, ruined), a common confusion of two similar characters.
gloss.zh: 颓圯：坍塌。“圯”在这里当作“圮”（pǐ，倒塌），两字形近，常被混用。
